title: Personal Training Packages: refund window, proration basis, and refund rate by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, the number of days after purchase within which a refund of unused sessions may be requested, which of the two prorating bases the tier uses to value the unused sessions, and the base percentage of that unused-session value refunded on an eligible cancellation. When a refund may actually be recorded, and how the unused-session value and the effective refund percentage are computed, are stated in the unused-session refund eligibility and recording-a-package-refund documents, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Refund window (days from purchase) | Proration basis | Base refund rate (percent of unused-session value) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | 2 | Sessions used | 80 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | 7 | Sessions used | 80 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | 7 | Sessions used | 80 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | 10 | Sessions used | 85 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | 3 | Percentage of the expiration window elapsed | 50 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | 10 | Sessions used | 85 |

## Points of reference
Five of the six tiers of Personal Training Packages value unused sessions on a sessions-used basis, meaning the count of sessions not yet consumed is what is valued; Unlimited Monthly Coaching is the sole exception, valuing its unused sessions instead on the fraction of its expiration window not yet elapsed, since an unlimited tier has no fixed per-session count to draw from. The refund window is narrowest on the entry-level Single Session Pack, at 2 days, and widest on the two highest tiers, 20-Session Performance Pack and Elite Specialty Coaching, at 10 days. The base refund rate is 80 percent on the three lower fixed-session tiers, rises to 85 percent on the two highest fixed-session tiers, and is 50 percent on Unlimited Monthly Coaching.
